column3: The Settings plugin-page browser test (web/e2e/settings-plugin.test.ts) runs by hand with bun test e2e, like every web/e2e test; CI does not run it yet
column4: Covering it needs a CI step (playwright install chromium-headless-shell, then bun test e2e/settings-plugin.test.ts), and the device token has no workflow scope, so the step is left for an owner with that scope. It cannot be a bun unit test: settings.tsx reads localStorage, document and window at import, and lucide-solid calls document.createElement
column5: web CI job runs typecheck and build only; settings.tsx import under bun test fails on localStorage; e2e passes 8/8 locally after the waitFor change
